name: LOLWEN
description: Claim LOLWEN after Banana Eats’ key escape and basement cake hunt. Includes the secret lobby door, eight slices and separate Floor 6 display claim.
steps: Join Banana Eats and choose Escape — One Banana for the recorded route. Play as a survivor; the creator uses this mode so only one player is Banana.
Find and pick up a Hollow Key on the round’s map. The recording shows it on the ground; no fixed spawn location was established. Keep the key and avoid Banana.

Survive until the exits open and escape with the key. The guide shows exits becoming available when the timer reaches 1:00; teammates completing puzzles can shorten the timer. Picking up the key without successfully escaping is not the completed objective.
Back in the Banana Eats lobby, find the red secret door by spawn in the cave area. Interact with it after escaping with the Hollow Key to enter Banana’s Basement.
Search the basement for eight cake slices. Follow the directional arrows and check both branches at hallway junctions; expect jump scares. Return to missed branches if the cake is not complete.
After collecting all eight slices, let the transition and cutscene finish. Walk forward to the prize in the new area to receive the event completion badge.
Return to The Hollow Hub on the same account. Take the elevator to Floor 6 and find the Banana Eats room, then interact with its reward display to claim LOLWEN.

Check AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / LOLWEN / Quest Reward and your avatar inventory separately. Conor3D’s final claim segment shows this named banner at 6:23. The original-game badge and the Hub item are separate steps. No Ticket payout amount or repeatable farming method was verified.
costLabel: Earned through the recorded quest; no Ticket-shop or Plus purchase shown
requirements: Complete the documented task and its final return or separate claim step.
Creator footage supports the route; no own-account test.

name: The Amazing Liquefactive Bighead
description: Earn the Bighead from the Floor 6 cauldron puzzle. Includes ingredient-color examples, correct order, relic collection and the elevator return.
steps: Enter The Hollow cinema elevator and select Floor 6. Search the right side of the floor for the Animal Hospital room. This Hub maze puzzle is separate from treating patients in the original Animal Hospital game.

Find the cauldron and read the three-color sequence it requests. Memorize the order before collecting ingredients. Use your current displayed sequence; the recording’s orange → green → red is an example, not a fixed code for every run.

Search the room and nearby area for ingredients with the matching colors. In the reviewed run, orange is a pumpkin, green is slime and red is berries. Do not substitute a differently colored ingredient just because it is nearby.

Carry the first required ingredient to the cauldron and add it. Repeat for the second and third colors in the displayed order. Adding the right colors in the wrong order does not satisfy the sequence.
After the correct third ingredient, collect the released relic. The creator’s sequence finishes with red berries at about 2:01–2:11 in the complete Day 6 recording.
Bring the relic safely back to the elevator. Completing the cauldron alone is not the end of the maze task; keep avoiding the floor’s monster until you return.

Check the named The Amazing Liquefactive Bighead / Puzzle Reward result after returning. The reviewed footage shows that named reward around 2:20. Check your own badge and avatar inventory separately; this is a video-based route, not our own-account test.
costLabel: Earned through the recorded quest; no Ticket-shop or Plus purchase shown
requirements: Complete the documented task and its final return or separate claim step.
Creator footage supports the route; no own-account test.

name: Mimic Hoodie
description: Earn Mimic Hoodie through Animal Hospital’s hazmat and photo-puzzle quest. Includes patient treatment, Shift 3 hand-in and the separate green Hub-display claim.
steps: Join Animal Hospital and find the platform labeled The Hollow. Start a shift in this event mode; this is separate from the Hub elevator maze and from The Mimic original game.
Complete Shift 1 patient check-ins. Take each patient’s picture, stamp the form and hand over their card, then visit the room they are assigned to.

Treat each patient in their room. Take a DNA sample, run it through the machine and read the diagnosis on the computer or TV. Get the requested treatment item from the vending machine and bring it back to that patient. Use the diagnosis shown in your run, not a fixed item list.
After Shift 1 ends, speak to the person in the hazmat suit in the lobby. This starts the slime-and-photo quest during Shift 2.

Use the vacuum on purple slime in the lobby and patient rooms. The recorded desktop control is to hold click while facing the slime. Some patches reveal a photo puzzle piece: collect it, and continue until you have all eight pieces.
Keep checking in and treating patients while searching. You must finish Shift 2 as well as the puzzle; collecting eight pieces alone does not finish the quest.

Solve the 3×3 sliding picture puzzle. Arrange the image of the dark rabbit-like figure with red eyes, a flask and laboratory background. Move pieces into the adjacent empty space. The creator solves the bottom row first, then the left column, then the remaining top-right 2×2. This is a strategy, not a universal click sequence.

Finish the remaining Shift 2 patients and reach Shift 3. Speak to the hazmat NPC again and finish the dialogue. The reviewed video shows QUEST COMPLETE and the Animal Hospital event badge toast at about 2:34.

Return to The Hollow Hub on the same Roblox account. To the left of spawn, find the green Animal Hospital display beside The Mimic doorway. Interact with the Animal Hospital reward display to claim the hoodie.

Check for AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Mimic Hoodie / Quest Reward and check your avatar inventory. BrosClanYt’s reviewed 11:00–11:31 claim chapter shows this named banner. The hospital completion panel’s purple ×100 currency is not proof of 100 Hollow Tickets; no Hub Ticket payout amount was verified.
costLabel: Earned through Animal Hospital’s event quest; no Ticket or Plus purchase shown
requirements: Complete the hospital’s event quest, including the Shift 3 NPC dialogue.
Claim at the Animal Hospital Hub display; the item name does not mean The Mimic’s carnival quest.
Creator recordings checked; no own-account delivery test.

name: Spore-Worn Traffic Cone
description: Spore-Worn Traffic Cone is the Floor 5 mirror-puzzle reward. Includes the complete beam sequence, relic return and the recorded item-obtained confirmation.
steps: Enter The Hollow cinema elevator and choose Floor 5. Find the puzzle room on the right side of this floor; do not enter The Mimic original-game portal for this maze task.
Inside the room, go upstairs to the right to find the reflection puzzle. Locate the black wall that emits the light and trace the beam from there. Rotate mirrors using their interaction prompts.

Connect the wall source to the pink mirror, then a yellow mirror, then another pink mirror. Follow the actual beam and nearby pedestals; repeated colors identify different mirrors, not repeated clicks on one mirror.
Send that pink mirror into the central yellow mirror. Continue across the room through two more yellow mirrors. This is the three-yellow segment shown at 1:12–1:26.
Continue the chain from yellow to green, then pink, then two mirrors with uncolored pedestals. Direct the second uncolored mirror into blue, then pink, then green.

Aim the final green mirror into the skull receiver. At 1:43 the original video shows this final connection. If the beam stops, work backward from the first unlit link; no universal click-count solution was established.
Collect the released relic and carry it safely back to the elevator. Solving the mirrors alone is not the final step; do not stop in the puzzle room.

After returning, check for AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Spore-Worn Traffic Cone / Puzzle Reward. This banner appears at about 1:55 in the reviewed recording. Check your own badge and avatar inventory separately; the site has not played on its own account.
costLabel: Earned through the recorded event quest; no Ticket-shop purchase shown
requirements: Complete the documented task and follow its separate return or claim step.
Creator footage reviewed; this site has not tested delivery on its own account.

name: Hiachi Grin Mask
description: Unlock Hiachi Grin Mask after The Mimic carnival, four relic puzzles and boss fight. The mask has a separate claim display left of the Hub spawn.
steps: Join The Mimic and pass through the two portals marked The Hollow. Select a single-player or multiplayer run. This is the original-game quest, separate from the Hub Floor 5 mirror puzzle.
In the carnival, follow the blue tent icons to seven minigames. The creator completes them in any order while monsters patrol; move between stations carefully.
Complete the dunk tank by timing four throws onto the bullseye. For Whack a Clown, click the clowns as they appear. For the balloon game, click the balloons to pop them.
Finish ring toss by landing six rings on bottles: aim, hold and release the throw. In mini golf, click and drag to line up the ball and release it into the hole.
For High Striker, repeatedly click to charge the meter three times. In basketball, hold and release when the indicator reaches the green section. Finish all seven games to reach the giant room.

Follow the four tent markers in the giant room to earn four relics. In The First Night puzzle, rotate the sun around the circle to match the target moon at the top right; the reviewed guide shows eight matches.

For the eye puzzle, watch which eyes appear in the mirrors and light the corresponding eyes in that order. The video example is 2, 1, 3; use your own displayed sequence rather than treating this as a fixed password.

For the card puzzle, track the correct card through five increasingly difficult shuffles. For the constellation puzzle, rotate the shapes until the lines connect. Collect the relic from each completed puzzle.

Once all four relics are collected, go to the basement to enter the boss fight. Use the axe to attack and continue through its rounds. The recorded guide says deaths can occur during this fight; do not infer a flawless-run requirement.
Finish the boss and check that the original-game badge is awarded. Return to The Hollow Hub and find the mask reward display to the left of spawn, among the game doorways.

Interact with the mask display. At about 5:10 the recording shows AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Hiachi Grin Mask / Quest Reward. Check your own inventory separately; earning the original-game badge and claiming the avatar item are separate actions.
costLabel: Earned through the recorded event quest; no Ticket-shop purchase shown
requirements: Complete the documented task and follow its separate return or claim step.
Creator footage reviewed; this site has not tested delivery on its own account.

name: Veil of Darkness
description: Claim Veil of Darkness after DTI’s 180-distance lantern-boat event. Includes the two fuel stops, completion badge and the Floor 5 reward-display interaction.
steps: From The Hollow cinema counter, use Visit Games to find Dress To Impress. In DTI, press The Hollow button at the bottom left to enter its event lobby. This is not a normal runway-show objective.
Walk down the lobby path to the boarding platforms and enter the event. On the boat, watch both the fuel reserve and the lantern meter; the travel target shown at the top is 180.
Take fuel from FUEL STORAGE and put it into the lantern. The reviewed desktop controls use holding E for both interactions. Keep transferring fuel so the boat continues moving.
When monsters board, use their interaction prompt to knock them off before they attack. The desktop recording uses holding E. Handle these threats as well as the lantern.
When fuel runs out and the boat stops, leave it to collect 10 fuel orbs around the area. Return to the boat with the collected fuel and resume feeding the lantern.
Repeat the boat routine, then collect fuel at the second stop. The video shows two collection stops and a final sailing leg; follow your current counters if the live encounter changes.
Reach 180 distance traveled. At the destination, follow the moving green orb down the path to the two NPCs and wait for the event completion badge.
Return to The Hollow Hub and take the elevator to Floor 5. Find the Dress To Impress room on the left side of the floor and approach the Veil of Darkness display.

Interact with the display to claim. At about 7:06 the reviewed video shows AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Veil of Darkness / Quest Reward. Check your own avatar inventory separately. No Tickets payout or own-account delivery is guaranteed by this guide.
costLabel: Earned through the recorded event quest; no Ticket-shop purchase shown
requirements: Complete the documented task and follow its separate return or claim step.
Creator footage reviewed; this site has not tested delivery on its own account.

name: Helmet of the Ossuary
description: A 60-Ticket cinema shop reward. The original purchase recording shows OWNED and the balance falling from 760 to 700.
costLabel: 60 earned Tickets; no Robux or Plus requirement shown in the recorded purchase
requirements: Have at least 60 credited Tickets. This is not a zero-Ticket claim.
Choose Helmet of the Ossuary in the standard Avatar Items row, separate from Plus items.
steps: Earn Tickets through a documented participating-game task and return to The Hollow. Review any REDEEM BADGES prompt and press Confirm to credit the listed amount. Check your current balance; task payouts can differ.
Enter the cinema main building and approach the concessions NPC. Open the Little Shop of Terror; the recorded route runs from the plaza to the counter at 0:25–0:40.
Select Helmet of the Ossuary in the standard Avatar Items row. At 0:40 its tile shows a Ticket icon and 60, with the buyer’s balance at 760. Check your actual live price.

Buy the helmet for 60 Tickets if the live panel matches. At 0:45 the selected helmet reads OWNED; at 0:50 the balance is 700 and its badge toast is visible. A badge listing alone does not prove a purchase.

Check the item in your Roblox avatar inventory separately. The shop says it will appear there soon; this site did not test delivery on its own account. If OWNED appears but the item is missing, retain the claim screen and check the correct account before spending again.

name: Haunted Harvest Crown
description: A 20-Ticket reward at the cinema concessions shop. The original recording shows the named purchase followed by AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED and a balance change from 300 to 280.
costLabel: 20 earned Tickets in the recorded shop; no Robux or Plus requirement shown
requirements: Have at least 20 credited Tickets in The Hollow hub; this is not a zero-Ticket claim.
Select Haunted Harvest Crown in the standard Avatar Items row. No Plus requirement is shown in the reviewed purchase.
steps: Earn Tickets through a documented participating-game task and return to The Hollow. Review any REDEEM BADGES prompt and press Confirm to credit the listed amount. Check your current balance; task payouts can differ.
Enter the cinema from the plaza and approach the concessions counter. Talk to the NPC and open the Little Shop of Terror; the recording shows the approach at 0:25–0:30.

Choose Haunted Harvest Crown in the standard Avatar Items row. At 0:40 the selected panel names the crown, shows a Ticket icon with 20 and the buyer’s balance at 300. Check the live panel before spending.

Buy the crown for 20 Tickets if the live panel matches. At 0:45 the video shows AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Haunted Harvest Crown / Shop Item and the balance at 280. The badge toast is additional evidence, not a substitute for this purchase result.

Check the item in your Roblox avatar inventory separately. The shop says it will appear there soon; this site did not test delivery on its own account. If OWNED appears but the item is missing, retain the claim screen and check the correct account before spending again.

name: The Great White Pumpkin
description: A 20-Ticket Avatar Items shop reward. Visit the cinema concessions counter, select the white pumpkin and buy it; the recording shows OWNED and AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED.
costLabel: 20 earned Tickets in the recorded shop; no Robux or Plus requirement shown
requirements: Have at least 20 Tickets credited in The Hollow hub. This item is not a zero-Ticket claim.
Choose The Great White Pumpkin in the standard Avatar Items row. Price and successful delivery were checked in a creator recording, not on our account.
steps: Earn Tickets through a documented participating-game task and return to The Hollow. Review any REDEEM BADGES prompt and press Confirm to credit the listed amount. Check your current balance; task payouts can differ.
Enter the cinema’s main building and talk to the concessions NPC at the counter. Open the Little Shop of Terror. The video reaches this counter from the plaza entrance at 0:30–0:35.

Find The Great White Pumpkin in the standard Avatar Items row, alongside the previously released shop items. The recorded tile shows a Ticket icon and 20, with the buyer’s balance at 660. Select the white pumpkin and check the actual live cost before buying.

Buy the selected item for 20 Tickets if the live panel matches. At 0:45 the recording shows The Great White Pumpkin marked OWNED, an AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED / Shop Item banner and the balance reduced to 640. A locked silhouette or timer alone is not evidence that the purchase completed.

Check the item in your Roblox avatar inventory separately. The shop says it will appear there soon; this site did not test delivery on its own account. If OWNED appears but the item is missing, retain the claim screen and check the correct account before spending again.

name: Anomaly Detection Rig
description: The four-crossover-visitor reward from Home Alone Anomalies. Earn the badge in First Night Story, then claim in the Home Alone house on Hub Floor 4.
steps: Join Home Alone Anomalies and select First Night in Story mode. The recorded run uses one player; the creator says other players are optional. Close the initial panels to enter the house.

Do household tasks while time advances and watch for crossover visitors. The video shows four visitors appearing during the night. Their exact identities and spawn times are not established as a universal schedule; the creator’s 3 a.m. and 4 a.m. sightings are examples.

Check the house notice board for the crossover-character tracker. Meet all four until it reads 4/4. The official objective is four characters, not surviving every night, buying equipment or collecting four ordinary household anomalies.

Wait for Crossover Hunter [The Hollow] to be awarded. Its official badge ID is 434944108901978. AFK completion is unverified: the creator completes tasks while waiting, so do not assume standing idle is sufficient.

Return to The Hollow hub and review any REDEEM BADGES prompt. The creator reports 10 Tickets in this run; that number is not a guaranteed current payout. The avatar item still has a separate claim location.

Take the cinema elevator to Floor 4 and find the Home Alone house room. Enter the house and use its reward display. The recording shows the Roblox Presents Anomaly Detection Rig badge award after the house claim at about 3:00. Check avatar inventory separately; this is a layered-clothing item and fit can vary by avatar. This site has not performed an own-account claim.
costLabel: Earned by meeting four crossover visitors; separate Floor 4 claim
requirements: Earn Crossover Hunter [The Hollow] by meeting all four crossover characters.
Use the Home Alone house reward display on Hub Floor 4. Layered-clothing fit varies.

name: Chrome Deer Skull Chain
description: The 99 Nights Void quest reward. Collect 20 red flowers after upgrading the fire to level 3, then claim the chain at its green doorway display in The Hollow hub.
steps: Join 99 Nights in the Forest and open The Hollow event button. Enter a normal game, chop trees with your axe, store logs in your bag and deposit them into the campfire until it reaches level 3. On the recorded desktop controls, F stores and drops logs.

At fire level 3, use The Hollow menu’s Find the Void tracker to locate the portal in the expanded zone. Stand on its platform and wait for the teleport countdown. Do not copy the creator’s cave position as a universal map coordinate.

Inside the Void, collect all 20 outlined red flowers. Approach a flower and use its interaction prompt (E in the desktop recording). Move between flowers and the yellow lantern areas, which the official badge description identifies as safe zones.

Choose an available upgrade after every three collected flowers. The recordings show options such as more lanterns, faster tree cutting and a speed boost after picking flowers; the available choices may differ. Use lanterns when enemies gather rather than trying to fight every spawn.

Some flowers are enclosed by Hollow trees. Cocajola’s recording shows cutting through the surrounding trees, with an upgrade that later reduces the chopping needed. Return to a lantern when threatened and continue from the same opening; do not mistake an enclosed flower for a missing collectible.

Collect the final flower and finish the cutscene. Check that you earned The Hollow 2026 badge, ID 2195398371010118. Dying in the Void returns you to the fire and allows another try, according to the official description; persistence of flower progress after death was not independently verified.

Return to The Hollow hub. If REDEEM BADGES appears, review the listed credits and press Confirm. Cocajola reports 10 Tickets in that recorded run; this is not a guaranteed current payout or a repeatable farming claim.

In the hub plaza, find the green 99 Nights in the Forest doorway and use the chain reward display beside it. SharkBlox’s recording shows Chrome Deer Skull Chain, Quest Reward and AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED at 3:41. Check your avatar inventory as a separate final confirmation; this site did not claim it on its own account.
costLabel: Earned through the 99 Nights Void quest; no Ticket purchase shown
requirements: Earn The Hollow 2026 badge in 99 Nights in the Forest, then claim at its hub display.
Omnipotence is not required. Video shows successful delivery on the recorded account; no own-account playtest.

name: Boo & Bub
description: The Floor 4 maze reward: follow the demonstrated tile path, collect the relic and escape to the elevator. The original recording ends on an Item Owned page.
steps: Enter the cinema elevator in The Hollow and select Floor 4. Explore the maze until you find the 99 Nights in the Forest room with a tiled floor and red laser barrier. The recording does not establish one fixed corridor route for every run.

Stop at the puzzle entrance and watch the demonstration character cross the tiles. Note the order of the glowing tiles from your starting side. Follow that demonstrated path rather than jumping over the red barrier or guessing a universal left/right code.

Walk the same tile sequence. If you step incorrectly, return to the start and watch the demonstration again; the video shows a failed attempt followed by a successful retry. Copy the path shown in your own puzzle.
Reach the far end and collect the relic. The video calls it a key and shows the message “Lovely! That’s another one safely in our hands!” with the floor lit green. Do not leave before collecting it.
Carry the relic back through the maze to the elevator, avoiding the Deer. Use the return route you remembered on entry; reaching the far side of the tile puzzle alone does not finish the run.

After returning, check the Boo & Bub badge and your avatar inventory separately. The creator shows Boo & Bub by Roblox with Item Owned at 1:37. That verifies the recorded account’s result, not delivery to every account or a playtest by this site.
costLabel: Earned through the Night 4 maze quest
requirements: Complete the Floor 4 tile-path puzzle and return with its relic.
Creator recording shows Item Owned; official API confirms badge identity. Not our account playtest.

name: Trick or Treat Tentacles
description: A Roblox Plus-only avatar item costing 60 Tickets. The recording shows OWNED and a balance change from 180 to 120; the award banner calls it Trick or Treat Squid.
costLabel: Roblox Plus subscription + 60 Tickets
requirements: Active Roblox Plus eligibility and 60 unspent event Tickets. This is not a free reward for every account.
steps: Earn event badges and credit them in The Hollow hub using Confirm when new badges appear. Keep at least 60 Tickets available.
Enter the cinema and approach the right-hand concession counter. Choose Shop to open Little Shop of Terror.
Scroll down to the Roblox Plus row under Avatar Items. Select Trick or Treat Tentacles, the purple squid with a witch hat. Verify ROBLOX PLUS ONLY and the 60-Ticket price.

Choose Buy only if your account has the required Plus eligibility and balance. In the recording, OWNED and AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED appear and the balance drops from 180 to 120. The award banner uses the name Trick or Treat Squid.
Check Roblox avatar inventory after claiming. The shop says it will appear soon; this guide verifies the recorded in-game transaction, not our own account or a separate external inventory check.

name: Burned Necrobloxicon

costLabel: 60 earned Tickets

Recorded successful shop claim; not an independent account playtest or a guarantee of delivery on every server.
steps: Earn event badges in participating games, return to The Hollow hub and use Confirm when new badges are offered for Tickets. Check your balance; this item costs 60 Tickets.
Enter the cinema and approach the concession counter on the right. Choose Shop to open Little Shop of Terror. Visit Games is the separate participating-game menu.
Under Avatar Items, select Burned Necrobloxicon, the floating book-pages item. Verify the name and 60-Ticket price before choosing Buy. Do not confuse it with a Plus-only item or a maze tool.

After buying, look for OWNED and AVATAR ITEM OBTAINED. The recording changes from 120 to 60 Tickets. The shop says the item will show in Roblox inventory soon; check your avatar inventory separately if it is not immediately visible.

name: Biter Fedora
description: Complete Demonology’s six-relic ritual, enter the portal and use the Biter Fedora Claim display on the left side of The Hollow hub.
steps: In Demonology, click The Hollow sticky notes at the top right and load into the event game. Follow the red marker on the compass at the top of the screen to find the altar. Avoid the monster while collecting the six relics.
Mirror: follow the mirror as it jumps between pedestals until you can collect it. In the recording it turns purple when obtained. Pick it up, equip it and bring it back to the altar.
Lantern: pick up the spectral flame and light the three lamps by holding the interaction key (E in the recording). Collect the lantern that appears in the middle and return it to the altar.
Book: interact with and read each sign in the area. Reading the final sign spawns the book; collect it and bring it to the altar.
Hourglass: stand inside the moving circle and walk with it. Stay inside until its progress indicator fills, then collect the hourglass and return it to the altar.

Lock: find the locked fence, then search nearby containers for a lockpick. Use it on the lock and click when the moving cursor is on the red segment of the minigame. Collect the lock relic and return it to the altar. The lockpick container in the video is an example, not a guaranteed spawn for every run.
Skull: pick up the shovel, dig the fresh grave, retrieve the skull and return it to the altar. Check that all six relics have been placed; carrying the final relic is not enough.
Begin the ritual, let the cutscene finish and walk into the portal. The creator reports receiving the Demonology event badge at this point.

Return to The Hollow hub on the same account. Look to the left for the Biter Fedora display by the green-lit entrance and interact with Claim. Check your avatar inventory afterward. The recording shows the Claim prompt; successful inventory delivery has not been independently tested here.
costLabel: Earned through the Demonology event quest
requirements: Collect and place all six relics, complete the ritual and enter the portal.
Return to the hub and use Claim; delivery is video-reported, not independently account-tested.

name: Cowboy Hat of the Dead
description: Complete Dead Rails Edison’s Revenge, then visit the left-hand hat display in the hub’s Floor 3 Dead Rails room.
steps: In Dead Rails, press Play and choose Edison’s Revenge, the second option in the recording. Search the walls around spawn for Investigate the stain. Interact, collect the key that appears below you, and use it on the train lock.
Enter the changed train and move through its carriages. Pick up weapons and ammunition along the way. At the first locked door, go outside and defeat enemies until you obtain the bank combination.

Take the combination into the bank. Click and drag the vault wheel clockwise to each successive number on your paper. The video uses 55434; use your own combination rather than treating this as a universal code. Collect the key inside and unlock the train door.

Continue to the next locked door and fight the enemies outside. The creator recommends finding a rifle before this section. After clearing the ordinary enemies, enter the prison and interact with the key on the rock.

Pulling the prison key triggers a boss fight. Defeat the boss, retrieve the key, return to the train and unlock the next door. Continue to the final carriage and cutscene; the creator reports receiving the event badge after being teleported back.

Return to The Hollow hub on the same account. Take the cinema elevator to Floor 3, explore until you find the Dead Rails room, and interact with the cowboy-hat display on the left. Check your avatar inventory after claiming. The video shows the display and describes claiming; independent inventory delivery has not been tested here.
costLabel: Earned through the Dead Rails event quest
requirements: Complete the recorded event quest and visit the separate hub display.
Claim route is video-reported; badge identity alone does not prove avatar inventory delivery.

name: Festering Felix
description: The Night 3 Floor 3 puzzle reward: identify the three shortest lifespans, open the coffin and return the relic to the elevator.
steps: Enter the hub cinema elevator and choose Floor 3. Explore until you reach the Demonology room with a coffin in the middle and eight graves around it. No identical maze route for every run is established.
Read the riddle beside the coffin. It asks for the three shortest lives, ordered from youngest to oldest, rather than the earliest birth or death years.

Record the symbol, birth date and death date on each of the eight graves. Calculate each lifespan, then sort the eight from shortest to longest. Use the full displayed dates if needed; do not rank by death date alone.

Take the symbols of the three youngest people in that order. At the coffin, use the arrows on Grave Lock slots I, II and III to match those three symbols from left to right. The video uses broom, witch and ghost; that is the recorded example, not a verified universal code.
Press Open. The recording shows the relic collected and a Got it message. If the coffin does not open, recheck all eight lifespans and the order of the three selected symbols.

Carry the relic safely back to the elevator. The video shows the return and reports the Festering Felix badge and avatar reward. Check both your badge list and avatar inventory; opening the coffin alone is not the final step. Inventory delivery was not independently tested on our account.
costLabel: Earned through the Night 3 maze quest
requirements: Complete the Floor 3 coffin puzzle and return with the relic.
Video-reported reward delivery; official API confirms badge identity only. No account playtest.

name: Fuwatty Side Satchel
description: Collect 50 event pumpkins in AO ONI Nightmare, then find its reward room on Floor 2 of The Hollow.
steps: In AO ONI Nightmare, walk into a side room and create a lobby or join an existing one.
Wait a few seconds for event pumpkins to appear. Interact with pumpkins around the map while avoiding monsters.
Collect the initial pumpkins and the new wave that appears when the game mode begins. Track the event counter toward 50 pumpkins.

The creator rejoins after collecting the available wave and reports progress accumulating to 50. Check that your counter persists before using this strategy; the claim that no more pumpkins spawn is specific to that recording.
After reaching 50 and receiving the event badge, return to The Hollow. Take the elevator to Floor 2 and locate the AO ONI Nightmare reward room.

Use that room’s reward interaction and check for Fuwatty Side Satchel in avatar inventory. The recording shows a banana-shaped display while the creator reports the satchel claim; verify the room and item result rather than relying on the display model.
costLabel: Earned through the Night 2 quest
requirements: AO ONI Nightmare: 50 pumpkins and Fuwatty Side Satchel
Recorded gameplay supports the route; successful delivery on every current server is not independently verified.

name: Reeling Petal Garland
description: Use the limited-time Hollow mode, accumulate 200 pumpkins, then claim the garland in the hub.
steps: In Dandy’s World, go to the left side of the lobby and enter the limited-time Hollow mode. Join its queue to start a round.
Complete machines, avoid monsters and work toward the exit. Collect pumpkins from the floor as you move.
The recording reports 1 pumpkin per floor pickup, 25 per completed machine and 50 per escape. Machines use a timing puzzle; finish all required machines to open the escape route.
Continue across rounds until the event pumpkin total reaches 200 and the event badge is awarded. This is cumulative in the reviewed guide, not a requirement to pick up 200 loose pumpkins in one run.
Return to The Hollow on the same account. Use the Dandy’s World reward display on the left side of the hub to claim Reeling Petal Garland, then check avatar inventory.
costLabel: Earned through the Night 2 quest
requirements: Dandy’s World: 200 pumpkins and Reeling Petal Garland
Recorded gameplay supports the route; successful delivery on every current server is not independently verified.

name: Witches Brew-nado
description: Use the annotated Floor 2 picture walkthrough to recognize the room, align the pillar faces, operate the lever and return the relic for Witches Brew-nado.
steps: Enter The Hollow hub cinema and take the elevator to Floor 2. In the recorded route, the Dandy-themed room is ahead through the right side of the open room. Look for flower furniture and rainbow wall trim, then go upstairs to the tall pillars on the purple floor. Use the annotated pictures above if the text alone is unclear; the recording does not establish an identical maze layout for everyone.
There are six pillars with four symbols each. Rotate one until it lights up to identify the target symbol. The creator’s target is a cat; do not assume every run uses that symbol.

Use a deliberate trial rather than turning every pillar at once: choose one control, rotate it once, and note every pillar that changes. Check the newly visible symbols before touching the next control. This is a suggested way to track the linked rotations, not a verified universal solution sequence.

Work toward the glowing target on all six pillars. If a turn changes a pillar you already aligned, include that linked pillar in your next adjustment. The linked-turn demonstration is at 1:28 in the linked video; the exact control-to-pillar mapping has not been independently established here.
When all six energy beams point into the middle, pull the central lever and collect the relic.

Return safely to the elevator with the relic. The creator identifies this return as the Witches Brew-nado reward trigger. Check your badge and avatar inventory; solving the pillars alone is not the final step.
costLabel: Earned through the Night 2 quest
requirements: Night 2 maze: six pillars and Witches Brew-nado
Recorded gameplay supports the route; successful delivery on every current server is not independently verified.

name: Gourdlord: The Entangled
description: The first standard avatar-shop reward costs 100 earned Tickets. Find it at the cinema concession counter under Avatar Items.
costLabel: 100 earned Tickets · no Plus requirement shown
requirements: 100 unspent Tickets. Ticket awards vary by game: observed menu values include 10 and 20.
Reviewed October 23 from gameplay and official item identity; availability can change.
steps: Complete participating-game event objectives and return to the hub. Confirm newly earned badge credit.
Enter the cinema, turn right to the concession counter and open the shop.
Choose Avatar Items, select Gourdlord: The Entangled and spend 100 Tickets.
Check the ownership confirmation and your Roblox inventory. Tickets are spent, not just counted toward a milestone.

name: Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin
description: Claim the Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin by completing the Floor 1 relic-and-vault objective. Includes the final elevator return and source timestamps.
costLabel: Earned through the event quest
requirements: Night 1 maze: five relics and Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin
Follow the completion and claim steps; a guide review is not a successful claim on your account.
steps: Enter the cinema in The Hollow and use the elevator at the back to reach Floor 1.
Search different rooms for five glowing purple relics while avoiding Seek. The demonstrated layout is variable: follow unexplored branches rather than a fixed left/right sequence.
After collecting all five, locate the large room and its side room leading to the DOORS area. Find the vault there.
Complete the vault puzzle by connecting the purple line across to the other side. Take the revealed relic/key.
Return to the elevator with the key. The walkthrough identifies this return as the completion trigger for the Lord Umberhallow BLOXikin badge and reward.

name: All-Seeking Antlers
description: Unlock All-Seeking Antlers through the DOORS Candy Vault event, then use the left-side display in The Hollow to collect the avatar reward.
costLabel: Earned through the event quest
requirements: DOORS Candy Vault: All-Seeking Antlers

steps: In DOORS, enter the limited-time Estate / Candy Vault mode. This is the event route, not a normal Hotel run.
Approach the mansion, let the opening scenes finish and enter the large vault straight ahead with your team.
Follow the numbered doors and descend through 50 rooms before the 20-minute timer expires. Keep moving toward the next numbered door; optional side rooms can lead back to your route.
At the final large cauldron room, cross to the far side and escape with your team.
Return to The Hollow cinema. Find the All-Seeking Antlers display on the left and use its claim interaction. Completing DOORS and claiming the hub item are separate steps.

name: The Beasthammer

steps: Join Flee the Facility and play an event-enabled round. As a survivor, hack computers and rescue teammates to earn candy; the recording also shows beast actions earning candy.
Carry candy to the event buckets around the map and deposit it. The guide reports a 30-candy carrying cap, so bank candy in batches.
Continue until the deposited event total reaches 100. Do not confuse the carrying counter with the banked total.
Escape a round as a survivor after reaching the 100-candy requirement. The reviewed guide says finishing as the beast does not satisfy this final step.
Return to The Hollow cinema and claim The Beasthammer from the reward display on the right.

steps: Credit earned event badges in the hub using Confirm.
Enter the cinema and open the shop at the right-hand concession counter.
Under Avatar Items, choose Quack-o'-Lantern in the Roblox Plus row.
Check the membership requirement and spend 20 Tickets. The recorded result shows OWNED; check Roblox inventory after the claim.
